bio_en: Sargis Chatalian, known as Bulgaratsi Sargis, was born in Bulgaria and was among the first graduates of the ARF's military school there. He went to the Caucasus and fought in the Armenian-Tatar clashes, then in 1906 moved to Van as a military instructor, taking part in many clashes and operations. After the 1908 constitution he married Marine, a girl from the Van orphanage. He later emigrated to the USA and died in Providence on 9 April 1959.
